payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates i from max to 1; if i not present, scans multiples j to find two present multiples a,b with a∤b. If found, marks i present and counts it. Effectively counts attainable gcds.
payload.rationale: Chosen as dp_1d_state because the solution uses a 1D boolean array representing presence of numbers, updated in a loop from high to low. However, it lacks a recurrence typical of DP, hence low confidence.
